body_text:
First isomorphism theorem for vector spaces. For a linear map
$T:V\to W$, the induced map $V/\ker T\to\operatorname{im}T$ given
by $v+\ker T\mapsto T(v)$ is a well-defined linear isomorphism.
The quotient removes exactly the directions on which $T$ loses
information.
